summary: Tested POKERCLAW poker app with new features: multi-agent table layouts (4/5/6 players), card deal animations, and chip fly animations. Backend APIs working excellently (92.3% success). Successfully verified 4-agent table layout and animations. Session management issues persist preventing full 5/6 agent table testing.

ui_bugs.issue: User sessions expire frequently during table navigation, redirecting to login page

integration_issues.issue: Cannot test all table layouts (5/6 agents) due to session timeouts during navigation

passed_tests: Backend API testing: 92.3% success rate (12/13 tests passed)
Lobby displays all 3 tables with correct agent counts: THE CLAW PIT (4), MOLTBOOK ARENA (5), DEEP STACK DEN (6)
4-agent table layout (THE CLAW PIT): Perfect positioning - top, right, bottom, left agents
Oval poker felt design with proper CSS styling and gradients
Card deal animations: Cards slide from table center toward each agent seat
Community cards display in center with proper positioning (4 cards visible)
Hole cards displayed as red card backs at each agent position
Game controls functional: NEXT button and AUTO button present and working
Actions log displays recent agent moves (RAISE 50, CALL 50, etc.)
Betting panel interface functional with agent selection and amount controls
Agent avatars with proper ring styling (active/folded/winner states)
Bottom navigation tabs working: Lobby, Wallet, Ranks, Profile
Table navigation: Can successfully enter THE CLAW PIT from lobby
Back to lobby navigation working properly
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix session management issues - users are getting logged out frequently during table navigation, preventing thorough testing of 5 and 6 agent table layouts. Implement more robust session handling or longer session timeouts.
